shirley-n-weber.text: Welcomed the U.S. Supreme Court decision blocking mail-voting restrictions: "The ruling on mail-in ballots has been made. The uncertainty is behind us. Now, let the people vote!"

source.title: Statement on Supreme Court Decision Rejecting Mail-In Voting Restrictions (CA SOS)

shirley-n-weber.text: On ballot counting: "For me, accuracy is far more important" than speed; important to count every ballot.

source.title: California's Race for Secretary of State Shows Partisan Divide over How to Count Ballots (Santa Barbara Independent)

shirley-n-weber.text: Resisted sharing voter information with the Trump Justice Department: "If we were giving (voter information) away like candy, who would trust us … to protect their records?"

source.title: California's Race for Secretary of State Shows Partisan Divide over How to Count Ballots (Santa Barbara Independent)

shirley-n-weber.text: Oversaw permanent implementation of universal mail-in voting; pledges to expand voting access and strengthen election cybersecurity.

source.title: CalMatters 2026 California Voter Guide: Secretary of State

shirley-n-weber.text: Endorsed by the California Democratic Party, California Federation of Teachers and SEIU California.
